summary: Retested the Multiproyectos fix that combines bank/product data from every quote. Ran test_multiprojects_matrix_iter410.py (6/6 pass) and a Playwright run through the UI, using only TEST_ clients and quotes that I created and then deleted. Quote A had Banco X/Prod A and quote B had Banco Y/Prod B. Results: preview returns 2 summaries, each with its own banks and services. After create, project_type is multirif. project.banks lists both banks, services holds both items, and the global implementation_matrix is {Banco X:{Prod A}, Banco Y:{Prod B}}. Each store keeps only its own quote's matrix. quote_summaries has 2 entries and GET /api/projects/{id} returns them. The Ficha Técnica PDF (/api/projects/{id}/ficha-tecnica, checked with pypdf) has two 'Resumen Ejecutivo — Cotización ...' blocks, each with its own bank and product. Regression check: a normal single project still renders exactly one 'Resumen Ejecutivo'. In the UI, the step 1 dialog shows mp-summaries with 2 correct cards. Creating the project goes to /projects/{id}, which shows project-quote-summaries with 2 cards. Found one remaining data bug: box counts (Cajas).

minor.issue: boxes = q.box_count or sum(branch_details.quantity) or 1. Real quotes never have box_count: the database has 0 quotes with box_count and 351 with cantidad_cajas. So every quote without branch_details reports 1 box in summaries[].box_count, stores[].box_count, rifs[].box_count and the PDF 'Cant. Cajas'. Fix: int(q.get('box_count') or q.get('cantidad_cajas') or sum(branch qty) or 1).

synth sets box_count, but _create_project_from_quote reads quote['cantidad_cajas'] (quote_transitions.py L234). As a result project.box_count is only the primary quote's count: the UI showed 'Nro de Cajas 1' for a 2-quote project. Fix: also set synth['cantidad_cajas'] = sum of boxes.

Code review, not tested: st.get('implementation_matrix') or rif_matrix. If a quote has no additional services, its store matrix is {}, which is falsy, so the store falls back to the global union matrix and gets other quotes' banks. Check whether the key is present instead of relying on truthiness.
The PDF prints 'Dir. Fiscal None' when the client address is null, because _cl.get('address','No especificada') only defaults when the key is missing. Use `_cl.get('address') or 'No especificada'`.

issues: The quote number appears twice, because store_name already includes '(quote_number)'.

action_items: In multiprojects._build, count boxes from cantidad_cajas
Set synth['cantidad_cajas'] to the total boxes
Don't fall back to the global matrix when a store's own matrix is an empty dict
In the PDF summary, show 'No especificada' instead of 'None' when the address is null
critical_code_review_comments: Create is still not atomic: quotes are archived before the project is created (already reported in iter409).
seed_data_creation: Only TEST_ clients and quotes (M410/U410) plus the 2 resulting projects, deleted by id. Checked 0 leftovers.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Run: python -m pytest test_multiprojects_matrix_iter410.py -p no:xdist, after loading backend/.env and setting REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL. UI fixture: ui_fixture_mp_iter410.py create|cleanup. Set session_token in localStorage, load /dashboard first, then go to /multiprojects.
rca of the issue: The requested fix works. The remaining box-count issue comes from a field name mismatch: the multiproject code reads box_count, but quotes store cantidad_cajas.
